description: This file contains the implementation of the UserProfile interface, managing user-specific configurations for ECU data logging, including profile parameters, switches, external data, and protocol handling.

classes.name: UserProfileImpl
classes.description: Implementation of UserProfile interface managing user profile data for ECU parameter logging, including profile serialization to XML.

methods.name: UserProfileImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the user profile with parameter, switch, external data maps, and protocol.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the profile contains data for the given LoggerData.

methods.name: isSelectedOnLiveDataTab
methods.description: Determines if the given LoggerData is selected for display on the live data tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnGraphTab
methods.description: Determines if the given LoggerData is selected for display on the graph tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnDashTab
methods.description: Determines if the given LoggerData is selected for display on the dashboard tab.

methods.name: getSelectedConvertor
methods.description: Returns the selected data convertor for the given LoggerData, or the default if none is selected.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Serializes the user profile into a byte array representing an XML profile document.

methods.name: buildXml
methods.description: Private method that constructs the profile XML string.

methods.name: appendLoggerDataElements
methods.description: Helper method that appends XML elements for logger data items.

methods.name: getUserProfileItem
methods.description: Retrieves the UserProfileItem associated with the given LoggerData.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Determines which map (params, switches, external) to use based on the type of LoggerData.
